# X509_ISSUANCE

Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `issuance`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.issuance`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| caSecret | null or record { key, name, namespace } |
| issuerRef | record { kind, name } |
| publicIssuer | bool |
